stages.title: Cranial Sphere & Head Tilt
stages.explanation: The cranial ball is the primary 3D anchor of the human head, establishing spatial volume and perspective tilt.
stages.drawing_action: Draw a clean sphere representing the cranial mass. Keep lines feather-light.

stages.title: Brow Equator & Central Facial Axis
stages.explanation: The horizontal brow line wraps around the sphere's equator; the vertical centerline defines facial direction.
stages.drawing_action: Wrap the brow equator and the vertical centerline across the sphere following head tilt.

stages.title: Eye Plane & Side Cranium Flattening
stages.explanation: The human skull is flattened at the temples; vertical disc truncation marks the ear placement plane.
stages.drawing_action: Slice off the side plane disc and drop the horizontal eye plane below the brow equator.

stages.title: Jaw Construction & Mandible Rhythm
stages.explanation: The mandible swings down from the ears like a bucket handle, tapering down to the chin wedge.
stages.drawing_action: Draw sweeping curves from temples to gonial angle and meet at the chin wedge.

stages.title: Nose Keystones & Midface Proportion
stages.explanation: Rule of Thirds: establishes the nasal septum base at the middle third mark along the facial axis.
stages.drawing_action: Mark the nasal septum keystone at the 1/3 division along the central facial axis.

stages.title: Mouth Rhythm & Dental Arc Cylinder
stages.explanation: The mouth rests on a barrel-like dental cylinder wrapping across the facial curvature.
stages.drawing_action: Place the oral fissure 1/3 down from the nose base to the chin along the cylindrical contour.

stages.title: Unified Loomis 3D Armature
stages.explanation: Harmonizes all foundation planes into a coherent 3D scaffolding ready for anatomical feature placement.
stages.drawing_action: Re-affirm major planes and check spatial alignment of brow, nose, and chin thirds.

stages.title: Orbital Sockets
stages.explanation: Blocks in the eye socket cavities recessed into the cranium beneath the brow bone shelf.
stages.drawing_action: Carve out the orbital sockets with light, angled hexagonal construction lines.

stages.title: Eyeball and Eyelid Construction
stages.explanation: Constructs the spherical eyeball, curving palpebral eyelid folds, tear duct, and dark pupil with catchlight.
stages.drawing_action: Wrap upper and lower eyelids over the eyeball sphere; place pupil and specular highlight.

stages.title: Eyebrow Arches
stages.explanation: Follows the superciliary ridge of the frontal bone with directional hair growth rhythms.
stages.drawing_action: Draw the eyebrow contour along the brow ridge with rhythmic pencil strokes.

stages.title: Sculpted Nose Construction
stages.explanation: Constructs the 4-plane nose keystone: bridge, side sloping planes, ball of the nose, and nostril wings.
stages.drawing_action: Define bridge planes, alar wings, and cast shadow beneath the nasal base.

stages.title: Cupid's Bow & Lip Refinement
stages.explanation: Maps the 5 lip cushions: 3 on upper lip (including Cupid's bow) and 2 on lower lip over the dental arch.
stages.drawing_action: Draw the oral fissure line of closure, Cupid's bow nodes, and philtrum columns.

stages.title: Zygomatic Cheeks & Temporal Lines
stages.explanation: Defines cheekbone contours and the temporal ridge separating face plane from cranium side plane.
stages.drawing_action: Trace the zygomatic arches from ear to upper lip and define forehead boundaries.

stages.title: Ear Architecture
stages.explanation: Anchors the outer ear between brow line and nose base: helix rim, antihelix, tragus, and lobe.
stages.drawing_action: Draw the C-curve of the helix and anchor the ear to the side plane vertical division.

stages.title: Hairline & Volumetric Hair Mass
stages.explanation: Captures the authentic hair silhouette, crown volume, partition, and framing locks of the subject.
stages.drawing_action: Block in the outer hair silhouette and rhythm lines radiating from crown/partition.

stages.title: Neck, Shoulders & Garment Drapery
stages.explanation: Anchors the head to the body via cervical cylinder, sternocleidomastoid muscles, clavicle, and dress lines.
stages.drawing_action: Draw neck cylinder, collar lines, necklace/choker, and shoulder drapery curves.

stages.title: Facial Refinement & Authentic Marks
stages.explanation: Refines jaw and cheek edges to capture distinct individual likeness, including beauty marks or bindi.
stages.drawing_action: Crispen facial boundary contours; place authentic forehead marks or dimples.

stages.title: Luminance-Aware Shadow Structures
stages.explanation: Analyzes reference illumination to lay in directional graphite cast shadows beneath chin and features.
stages.drawing_action: Lay down unified directional shadow planes matching key light source.

stages.title: Secondary Details & Ornamentation
stages.explanation: Renders intricate jewelry facets, fabric texture rhythms, and escaping hair wisps.
stages.drawing_action: Add delicate graphite accents: jewelry sparkles, embroidery lines, fine eyelashes.

stages.title: Master Classical Graphite Portrait
stages.explanation: Harmonizes faint underlying Loomis armature with rich, expressive graphite portraiture.
stages.drawing_action: Final tonal pass, deep graphite accents, subtle paper tooth unification.
